entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed, I really saved up for these.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?

It's the spin class cycling shoes I bought. No matter what I do, they're giving me horrible blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, thinking that was the problem, but it's not.
Oh, that sounds incredibly painful and certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Getting blisters can ruin any ride. Let me pull up your account to check the purchase date.
Thank you. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was just really hoping I could get a refund. Honestly, I really needed this money back.
I completely understand. Let's see... Okay, I see your order. You received the shoes about 40 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, you're serious? So I can get a refund? That's... that's such a relief. I was so worried.

Yes, absolutely. Since the cycling shoes are causing you blisters, we can process this as a return for a full refund. I've just initiated that for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file.
Wow. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a huge help. I'll get those sent back right away.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
